ValidationRule.description: C3 Provider Records can't have their names changed other than by the API Only User.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name = "C3 Provider", $User.Alias <> "apionly", OR( ISCHANGED(FirstName), ISCHANGED(LastName) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The name can only be changed through a Change Request. Please go to the associated Account and click the Change Request button on the top right-hand side of the screen.
